description: This file implements functions related to reading and processing oil pressure sensor data in the engine control system. It provides functionality to check sensor presence and to obtain interpolated oil pressure values based on analog input.

methods.name: hasOilPressureSensor
methods.description: Checks if the engine configuration includes an oil pressure sensor by verifying its hardware channel.

methods.name: getOilPressure
methods.description: Returns the current oil pressure by reading analog voltage, then interpolating the value based on sensor calibration data.
